purpose: The single canonical mapping between the company's external commercial designations (the names the company sells and negotiates under), the external portfolio sequence (01-15), and the immutable historical package IDs (provenance layer). Historical package IDs are PROVENANCE, never commercial identity: a buyer-facing document uses the company designation; the historical ID belongs to the machine-readable provenance layer.
